validation_errors.scope: One highest-scoring accepted segment per UID, first stored on ties; observed direction, not verified client/service role. Aggregate bins only, no endpoint/UID/feature rows.

resources.scope: Frame loading, six pattern audits, fits/scoring, serialization and repeats; excludes imports, preparation, verification and encryption. RSS sampled every 50 ms, not an OS-enforced bound.

scope: Experimental accepted-label capture/time comparison only; all warm-up/excluded rows retained, only accepted labels fit. No metadata/endpoint identities enter model inputs. Device independence and DDoS label coverage remain unresolved. Research models may be exported privately under the separate encrypted-transfer protocol; no public weights or raw/derived real rows.
